combo_label: The Village Fete × Herbs & Spices × Bletchley Park

entries.clue: Iced and filled sponge on the home baking stall, sold by the slice or whole
Red powder ground from dried sweet peppers, the colour and heart of a goulash
Cover name for the intelligence won from broken enemy signals, seen by very few
Hot brown brew poured from a big metal urn in the refreshment tent, milk already in it
Daily paper whose January 1942 puzzle contest doubled as a hunt for recruits
Stubby stone club, its rounded end worked in circles to crush whole seeds
German forces' rotor machine, its settings changed at midnight every day
Coloured rotating cylinder standing in for a wheel; 108 of them whirred on each machine
One plant gives both a warm citrus seed and a fresh leaf that tastes of soap to some
Wet smacking sound; the fete game of that name needs a drainpipe, a toy rat and a stick
